# vyos.blueprints.l2tp_lns

L2TP network server (docs blueprint "PPPoE over L2TP")

- Terminates PPP sessions tunnelled over L2TP from a LAC (for example PPPoE subscribers forwarded by a Cisco LAC) - authentication (RADIUS or local users), client address pools, gateway address, the LAC's tunnel host-name and shared secret, name servers and PPP options.
- Configured with vyos.vyos.vyos_config, because vyos.vyos has no L2TP module. Keys, the shared secret and local passwords are masked in rendered output.
- Masquerading the client pool belongs to `vyos.blueprints.nat`; the default route to `vyos.blueprints.base`.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.l2tp_lns
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `l2tp_lns_authentication` | dict |  |  | Authentication. Nothing is configured when unset. |
| `l2tp_lns_authentication.mode` | str | yes |  | Authentication mode. |
| `l2tp_lns_authentication.radius_servers` | list |  | `[]` | RADIUS servers (mode radius). |
| `l2tp_lns_authentication.radius_servers.address` | str | yes |  | Server address. |
| `l2tp_lns_authentication.radius_servers.key` | str | yes |  | Shared secret. |
| `l2tp_lns_authentication.local_users` | list |  | `[]` | Local users (mode local). |
| `l2tp_lns_authentication.local_users.username` | str | yes |  | User name. |
| `l2tp_lns_authentication.local_users.password` | str | yes |  | Password. |
| `l2tp_lns_pools` | list |  | `[]` | Client IPv4 address pools. |
| `l2tp_lns_pools.name` | str | yes |  | Pool name. |
| `l2tp_lns_pools.range` | str | yes |  | Address range or prefix, e.g. `10.0.0.2-10.0.0.100`. |
| `l2tp_lns_default_pool` | str |  | `''` | Default pool name. |
| `l2tp_lns_gateway_address` | str |  | `''` | Server-side address of the PPP sessions. |
| `l2tp_lns_lac_host_name` | str |  | `''` | Host name the LAC presents (`local name` on a Cisco LAC). |
| `l2tp_lns_shared_secret` | str |  | `''` | L2TP tunnel password (`l2tp tunnel password` on a Cisco LAC). |
| `l2tp_lns_name_servers` | list |  | `[]` | DNS servers handed to clients. |
| `l2tp_lns_ppp_options` | dict |  | `{}` | PPP options, e.g. `{disable_ccp: true}` as the page requires; keys map to `ppp-options <key>`. |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks the L2TP server is running and lists its sessions.

No variables.
